A conforming witness: a GLOBAL BEFORE REPORTING declarative PERFORMs a paragraph of a non-GLOBAL declarative section, which USE SR4 allows, and that paragraph executes GOBACK. Probe gb-range-decl-on.cob at --std 2002 prints IN-D1, IN-D2, then ends with abnormal termination on EC-FLOW-GLOBAL-GOBACK (fatal), rc=1. With checking off, gb-range-decl-off.cob gives rc=0 and the GOBACK acts as STOP. Lead for another row: a violation of USE SR3 draws only a warning.
